groups.instructions: Read the following report about the future population of a town. Then choose the correct ending for each sentence. There is one extra ending in column 2. /5 x 1 = 5 points/
groups.context:
Riverton: population report

The town of Riverton had 48,000 residents in 2020. According to the town council's projections, the population will reach about 60,000 by 2035, mainly because new factories are attracting young families from other regions.

The age structure of the town is also expected to change. The number of children under 15 will rise from 9,000 to around 13,000 by 2035, so at least two new schools will be needed. At the same time, the number of people aged 65 or more will almost double, from 6,000 to 11,000. The council therefore plans to build a new hospital before 2030.

After 2035, growth is expected to slow down, and the population will probably remain stable at around 60,000.

groups.title: Listening
groups.instructions: You are going to listen to a dialogue between a radio presenter and a woman who flies hot-air balloons. For questions 41-46 decide which of the choices A, B, C, D or E is the correct answer. You have 45 seconds to look through the questions before you listen. You will listen twice only, so listen carefully. /6 x 2 = 12 points/
groups.context:
Presenter: Today on 'Adventure Hour' I'm talking to Emma Roberts, who flies hot-air balloons. Emma, how did you start?
Emma: Well, for my twentieth birthday my parents gave me a balloon flight as a present. I loved it so much that I started lessons the following month. Now I've been a pilot for fifteen years.
Presenter: Is it dangerous?
Emma: It can be, if you don't respect the weather. A balloon can't really be steered. It goes where the wind takes it. So the most important skill is reading the weather. We never fly if the wind is stronger than about fifteen kilometres an hour.
Presenter: You had a famous adventure in Turkey a few years ago, didn't you?
Emma: Yes. I was flying with eight passengers over Cappadocia when the wind suddenly changed direction and became much stronger. We were heading towards some power lines.
Presenter: That sounds frightening! What did you do?
Emma: I told everybody to sit down and hold on, and I took the balloon up higher, above the power lines. Then I looked for an open field and made a fast landing. The basket fell on its side, but nobody was hurt, just a few bruises.
Presenter: Amazing. Do you train other pilots now?
Emma: Yes. I mostly teach young pilots how to stay calm and make decisions under pressure. Flying the balloon is the easy part!
Presenter: Emma Roberts, thank you.

questions.prompt: The museum is closed ___ Mondays and ___ public holidays.
questions.explanation: Гарагийн нэр (“Mondays”) болон баярын өдрийн (“public holidays”) өмнө өдөр заадаг “on” угтвар үг ордог тул “on / on”; “at” нь цагийн агшинд, “in” нь сар, улиралд хэрэглэгдэнэ.

questions.prompt: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius.
questions.explanation: Ус 100 хэмд буцалдаг нь байгалийн ерөнхий үнэн тул одоо энгийн цаг хэрэглэнэ; “Water” тоологдохгүй нэр үг бөгөөд ганц тооны үйл үг авдаг тул “boils”.

questions.prompt: I ___ to Japan in 2019 with my school.
questions.explanation: “in 2019” гэж өнгөрсөн тодорхой оныг заасан тул одоо төгссөн цаг биш, өнгөрсөн энгийн цаг хэрэгтэй; “go”-ийн дүрмийн бус өнгөрсөн хэлбэр нь “went”.

questions.prompt: They ___ married for twenty years, and they are still very happy.
questions.explanation: “for twenty years” ба “they are still very happy” нь өнгөрсөнд эхэлсэн байдал одоо ч үргэлжилж байгааг заадаг тул одоо төгссөн цаг; “They” олон тоо тул “have been married”.

questions.prompt: We're ___ dinner at a new restaurant tonight. Would you like ___ with us?
questions.explanation: “tonight” гэж өнөө оройн тохиролцоог хэлж байгаа тул ирээдүйн утгатай одоо үргэлжилж буй цаг (“We're having”) хэрэглэнэ; урих хэллэг “Would you like” нь инфинитив шаарддаг тул “having / to come”.

questions.prompt: That's the man ___ car was stolen last night.
questions.explanation: Хулгайд алдсан машин тэр эрэгтэйнх тул эзэмшил заадаг харьцангуй төлөөний үг “whose” орж “whose car” (машин нь) болно; “who”, “which” нэр үгийн өмнө эзэмшил илэрхийлэхгүй.

questions.prompt: You ___ wear a uniform at our school. It's a rule.
questions.explanation: “It's a rule” (энэ бол дүрэм) гэсэн нь заавал биелүүлэх үүргийг заадаг тул модаль үйл үг “must” орно; “can”, “might”, “could” нь зөвшөөрөл, боломжийг илэрхийлнэ.

questions.prompt: My parents let me ___ to the concert alone.
questions.explanation: “let” үйл үгийн дараа хүн, түүний ард “to”-гүй инфинитив ордог тул “let me go” (намайг явуулдаг); “let me to go” гэвэл алдаа болно.

questions.prompt: English ___ in many countries around the world.
questions.explanation: “English” нь ярих үйлийг гүйцэтгэгч биш, хүмүүсийн ярьдаг зүйл тул үйлдэгдэх хэв хэрэгтэй; олон оронд байнга үнэн байдаг баримт учир одоо энгийн цагт “is spoken” болно.

questions.prompt: Today is ___ day of the year so far.
questions.explanation: “of the year so far” гэж оны бүх өдрөөс хамгийн халуун нь болохыг заасан тул хамгийн дээд зэрэг хэрэгтэй; нэг үетэй “hot” богино эгшгийн араас “t”-ээ давхарлаж “the hottest” болно.

questions.prompt: If you ___ the bus, you ___ late for school.
questions.explanation: Автобуснаас хоцрох нь ирээдүйд бодитоор тохиолдож болох тул 1-р төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэр хэрэглэнэ: “miss / will be”; “would be” нь бодит бус нөхцөлд (2-р төрөл) ордог.

questions.prompt: He asked me if I ___ to the party the next day.
questions.explanation: “Are you coming to the party tomorrow?” гэсэн шууд асуулт шууд бус ярианд шилжихдээ цаг нь нэг шат ухарч “was coming” болж, “tomorrow” нь “the next day” болдог.

questions.prompt: Teaching is a very rewarding ___.
questions.explanation: “profession” нь тусгай мэдлэг, сургалт шаарддаг мэргэжил (багш, эмч гэх мэт) тул “a very rewarding profession” гэж сэтгэл ханамж өгдөг мэргэжлийг хэлнэ; “salary” цалин, “employer” ажил олгогч.

questions.prompt: Our new neighbour is very ___. She always says hello and offers to help.
questions.explanation: Хөрш нь “always says hello and offers to help” буюу үргэлж мэндэлж, тусламж санал болгодог нь “friendly” (найрсаг) зан; “rude”, “selfish”, “mean” нь сөрөг утгатай.

questions.prompt: The scientists returned from a three-month ___ to the South Pole.
questions.explanation: Эрдэмтдийн өмнөд туйл руу хийсэн гурван сарын урт, судалгааны аяллыг “expedition” (экспедиц) гэнэ; “excursion”, “picnic”, “outing” нь богино, зугаа цэнгэлийн аялал.

questions.prompt: I'm ___ that he will win. He's the best player in the team.
questions.explanation: “He's the best player in the team” гэсэн нь түүнийг ялна гэдэгт итгэлтэй байгааг харуулдаг тул “confident” (итгэлтэй); “doubtful”, “unsure”, “uncertain” нь эргэлзсэн гэсэн эсрэг утгатай.

questions.prompt: After the ___, the whole town was covered in deep snow and the roads were closed.
questions.explanation: Хот бүхэлдээ “covered in deep snow” болж, замууд хаагдсан нь “blizzard” буюу цасан шуурганы үр дагавар; “drought” ган, “heatwave” халуун, “flood” үер гэсэн утгатай.

questions.prompt: I ___ for being late. The traffic was terrible.
questions.explanation: Хоцорсныхоо төлөө уучлалт гуйхыг “apologize for” гэдэг: “I apologize for being late”; “blame” буруутгах, “forgive” уучлах, “accuse” яллах гэсэн утгатай.

questions.prompt: The film was absolutely <u>terrific</u>; we loved every minute.
questions.explanation: “we loved every minute” гэснээс кино маш их таалагдсан нь харагдах тул “terrific” нь “excellent” (гайхалтай сайн) гэсэн утгатай; үсгээрээ төстэй боловч эсрэг утгатай “terrible”-тэй андуурч болохгүй.

questions.prompt: The doctor told him to <u>avoid</u> sugary drinks.
questions.explanation: “avoid” нь ямар нэг зүйлээс зайлсхийх гэсэн утгатай тул “stay away from”; эмч чихэрлэг ундаа уухгүй байхыг зөвлөсөн бөгөөд “drink more” нь эсрэг санаа.

questions.prompt: The village is <u>remote</u>; the nearest town is 200 km away.
questions.explanation: “the nearest town is 200 km away” гэсэн тайлбар тосгон хот суурингаас алслагдсаныг харуулдаг тул “remote” нь “far away” (алс хол) гэсэн утгатай.

questions.prompt: I ran ___ an old classmate at the supermarket yesterday.
questions.explanation: “run into somebody” нь хэн нэгэнтэй санамсаргүй тааралдах гэсэн хэлц үйл үг: “an old classmate at the supermarket” гэж хуучин ангийн найзтайгаа дэлгүүрт таарсныг өгүүлж байна.

questions.prompt: Can you look ___ my plants while I'm away?
questions.explanation: “look after” нь асарч хамгаалах, харж хандах гэсэн утгатай; “while I'm away” (намайг байхгүй үед) ургамлыг минь хараарай гэж байгаа тул “look after”, харин “look for” хайх гэсэн утгатай.

questions.prompt: The fire alarm went ___ in the middle of the lesson.
questions.explanation: Дохиолол, сэрүүлэг гэнэт дуугарахыг “go off” гэдэг: галын дохиолол “in the middle of the lesson” (хичээлийн дундуур) дуугарсан; “go out” нь гал, гэрэл унтрах гэсэн өөр утгатай.

questions.prompt: We need to set ___ early tomorrow because the journey is long.
questions.explanation: “set off” нь аялалд гарах, замд мордох гэсэн хэлц үйл үг; “because the journey is long” гэдэг нь эрт гарах шалтгаан, харин “set up” нь байгуулах гэсэн утгатай.

questions.prompt: ___ is someone who designs buildings.
questions.explanation: Барилгын зураг төслийг боловсруулдаг хүнийг “An architect” (архитектор) гэнэ; “A builder” нь түүнийг барьдаг, “A plumber” сантехникч, “A carpenter” мужаан.

questions.prompt: ___ is someone who studies the weather and makes forecasts.
questions.explanation: Цаг агаарыг судалж, урьдчилсан мэдээ гаргадаг хүн бол “A meteorologist” (цаг уурч); “An astronomer” од гаригийг, “A geologist” газрын чулуулгийг судалдаг.

questions.prompt: He's quite shy, but very kind.
questions.explanation: “quite shy, but very kind” гэж зан чанарыг тодорхойлсон тул “What is he like?” (ямар хүн бэ) гэсэн асуултын хариулт; гадаад төрхийг “What does he look like?”, сонирхлыг “What does he like?” гэж асууна.

questions.prompt: Since 2018.
options: How long have you lived here?
answers: How long have you lived here?
questions.answerDisplay: How long have you lived here?
questions.explanation: “Since 2018” нь эхэлсэн цэгээс одоог хүртэлх хугацааг заадаг тул одоо төгссөн цагтай “How long have you lived here?” гэсэн асуултын хариулт; “When will you move?” ирээдүйг асууна.

questions.prompt: It's 5,000 tugriks.
questions.explanation: “It's 5,000 tugriks” гэж мөнгөн дүн хэлсэн тул үнэ асуудаг “How much is it?” байна; “How many are there?” тоо ширхэг, “How long is it?” урт асуудаг.

questions.prompt: By bus, usually.
options: How do you get to work?
When do you go to work?
answers: How do you get to work?
questions.answerDisplay: How do you get to work?
questions.explanation: “By bus” гэж унааны хэрэгслийг хэлсэн нь “How do you get to work?” (ажилдаа юугаар явдаг вэ) гэсэн асуултын хариулт; “When”, “Who” нь цаг, хүн асууна.

questions.prompt: It's mine. I left it here this morning.
questions.explanation: “It's mine” (минийх) гэж эзэмшигчийг хэлсэн тул хэнийх болохыг асуудаг “Whose umbrella is this?” гэсэн асуулт таарна; “Where is your umbrella?” гэвэл байршлыг хэлэх байсан.

questions.prompt: According to the text, monarch butterflies
questions.passage: The Long Journey of the Monarch Butterfly
options: fly up to 4,000 km to Mexico in autumn.
answers: fly up to 4,000 km to Mexico in autumn.
questions.answerDisplay: fly up to 4,000 km to Mexico in autumn.
questions.explanation: 1-р догол мөрөнд эрвээхэйнүүд намар бүр (“Every autumn”) урагш нисдэг бөгөөд “Their journey can be as long as 4,000 kilometres, and it ends in a few mountain forests in central Mexico” гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: Fred Urquhart
questions.passage: The Long Journey of the Monarch Butterfly
options: found the Mexican forests himself in 1975.
studied the butterflies' journey for many years.
answers: studied the butterflies' journey for many years.
questions.answerDisplay: studied the butterflies' journey for many years.
questions.explanation: 2-р догол мөрөнд Фред Уркхарт “spent decades trying to answer this question” гэжээ, өөрөөр хэлбэл олон жил судалсан; ойг өөрөө биш, “two members of his team” олсон.

questions.prompt: The volunteers helped by
questions.passage: The Long Journey of the Monarch Butterfly
options: putting small labels on butterflies' wings.
answers: putting small labels on butterflies' wings.
questions.answerDisplay: putting small labels on butterflies' wings.
questions.explanation: Сайн дурынхан “attached tiny paper labels to the wings of butterflies” буюу эрвээхэйн далавчинд жижиг цаасан шошго наасан бөгөөд олсон хүн бүрээс мэдээлэхийг хүссэн.

questions.prompt: The butterflies that fly south in autumn
questions.passage: The Long Journey of the Monarch Butterfly
questions.explanation: 3-р догол мөрөнд “Summer monarchs live for only two to six weeks” гэж, харин урагш нисдэг үеийг “can live for up to eight months” гэж бичсэн тул тэд зуны эрвээхэйнээс хамаагүй удаан амьдардаг.

questions.prompt: How do monarchs find their way, according to scientists?
questions.passage: The Long Journey of the Monarch Butterfly
options: They use the sun and the Earth's magnetic field.
They use the smell of milkweed.
answers: They use the sun and the Earth's magnetic field.
questions.answerDisplay: They use the sun and the Earth's magnetic field.
questions.explanation: Эрдэмтэд “the butterflies use the position of the sun and the Earth's magnetic field to find their direction” гэж үздэг; өөрөөр хэлбэл нар ба дэлхийн соронзон орноор чиглэлээ олдог.

questions.prompt: What does "it" in paragraph 4 refer to?
questions.passage: The Long Journey of the Monarch Butterfly
questions.explanation: “Their caterpillars can only eat one kind of plant, milkweed. Unfortunately, it is disappearing” гэсэн дараалалд “it” нь яг өмнө нь нэрлэсэн ургамлыг заана; ферм томрох тусам алга болж байгаа нь “milkweed”.

questions.prompt: Why has the number of monarchs fallen?
questions.passage: The Long Journey of the Monarch Butterfly
options: Because of cold winters in Canada.
Because their food plant and winter forests are being lost.
Because they cannot find their way.
answers: Because their food plant and winter forests are being lost.
questions.answerDisplay: Because their food plant and winter forests are being lost.
questions.explanation: 4-р догол мөрөнд авгалдайн цорын ганц хоол болох ургамал “is disappearing” гэж, Мексикт “illegal cutting of trees has damaged the winter forests” гэж бичсэн; хоол ба өвөлжөө хоёул алга болж байна.

questions.prompt: The guide's words suggest that
questions.passage: The Long Journey of the Monarch Butterfly
options: only Mexico should protect the butterflies.
countries must work together to protect the butterflies.
butterflies should stay in one country.
answers: countries must work together to protect the butterflies.
questions.answerDisplay: countries must work together to protect the butterflies.
questions.explanation: Хөтөч “The butterflies don't know borders. If we want to keep them, we have to protect them everywhere” гэсэн нь хил мэддэггүй эрвээхэйг бүх улс хамтран хамгаалах ёстойг илэрхийлнэ.

questions.prompt: If I see Tsetseg, …
options: … he could catch the first train.
… how many bones there are in the human body.
… as long as you are careful with it.
… if you found a wallet in the street?
… if you will find a wallet in the street?
questions.explanation: “If I see Tsetseg” нь бодит боломжтой ирээдүйн нөхцөл (1-р төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэр) тул гол хэсэг “will”-тэй байна: “… I'll give her your message”; энд “her” нь Цэцэгийг заана.

questions.prompt: What would you do …
options: … he could catch the first train.
… how many bones there are in the human body.
… as long as you are careful with it.
… if you found a wallet in the street?
… if you will find a wallet in the street?
answers: … if you found a wallet in the street?
questions.answerDisplay: 5. … if you found a wallet in the street?
questions.explanation: “What would you do …” дахь “would” нь төсөөллийн нөхцөл (2-р төрлийн нөхцөлт өгүүлбэр) тул “if” хэсэгт өнгөрсөн энгийн цаг ордог: “… if you found a wallet in the street?”; “if you will find” гэж хэлдэггүй.

questions.prompt: He got up early so that …
options: … he could catch the first train.
… how many bones there are in the human body.
… as long as you are careful with it.
… if you found a wallet in the street?
… if you will find a wallet in the street?
answers: … he could catch the first train.
questions.answerDisplay: 1. … he could catch the first train.
questions.explanation: Эрт боссон шалтгаан нь анхны галт тэргэнд суух зорилго тул “so that”-ийн араас өнгөрсөн хэлбэрийн “could” бүхий “… he could catch the first train” тохирно.

questions.prompt: The quiz question asked us to guess …
options: … he could catch the first train.
… how many bones there are in the human body.
… as long as you are careful with it.
… if you found a wallet in the street?
… if you will find a wallet in the street?
answers: … how many bones there are in the human body.
questions.answerDisplay: 2. … how many bones there are in the human body.
questions.explanation: “guess” үйл үгийн араас орсон асуулт шууд бус асуулт болж, “there are” гэж хүүрнэх дарааллаар бичигдэнэ: “… how many bones there are in the human body” (хүний биед хэдэн яс байдгийг).

questions.prompt: You can borrow my laptop …
options: … he could catch the first train.
… how many bones there are in the human body.
… as long as you are careful with it.
… if you found a wallet in the street?
… if you will find a wallet in the street?
answers: … as long as you are careful with it.
questions.answerDisplay: 4. … as long as you are careful with it.
questions.explanation: Зөөврийн компьютер зээлэх зөвшөөрөлд болзол нэмж байгаа тул “as long as” (зөвхөн …тохиолдолд) бүхий “… as long as you are careful with it” (болгоомжтой хэрэглэвэл) тохирно.

questions.prompt: 'How was your holiday?'
questions.explanation: “How was your holiday?” гэж амралт ямар байсныг асуухад үнэлгээ өгч “Fantastic. The weather was perfect.” гэж хариулна; асуулт, хариулт хоёулаа өнгөрсөн цагт байна.

questions.prompt: 'Can I take your coat?'
questions.explanation: “Can I take your coat?” гэсэн туслах саналыг хүлээн авч талархахдаа “Thanks, that's kind of you.” (баярлалаа, та их эелдэг юм) гэж хэлнэ.

questions.prompt: 'Do you mind if I open the window?'
questions.explanation: “Do you mind if I open the window?” нь та дургүйцэх үү гэсэн утгатай тул зөвшөөрөхдөө “Not at all. Go ahead.” (огт үгүй, нээгээрэй) гэнэ; “Yes” гэвэл эсэргүүцсэн болно.

questions.prompt: 'What's your new flat like?'
questions.explanation: “What's your new flat like?” нь байр ямар байгааг тодорхойлуулах асуулт тул “Small but very comfortable.” (жижиг ч гэсэн их тухтай) гэж хариулна.

questions.prompt: 'Why don't we go to the cinema?'
questions.explanation: “Why don't we go to the cinema?” нь санал болголт тул “Good idea. What's on?” (сайн санаа, ямар кино гарч байна) гэж зөвшөөрч хариулна.

questions.prompt: Gap a)
questions.explanation: Улаан өнгөнд дуртай хүмүүс “always busy and full of life” (үргэлж завгүй, амьдралын эрч хүчээр дүүрэн) гэсэн тул “energetic” (эрч хүчтэй) орно.

questions.prompt: Gap b)
questions.explanation: Цэнхэрт дуртай хүмүүс “rarely get angry or stressed” буюу бараг уурлаж, бухимддаггүй тул “calm” (тайван).

questions.prompt: Gap c)
questions.explanation: “good at solving everyday problems” (өдөр тутмын асуудлыг сайн шийддэг) гэсэн нь “practical” (практик, амьдралч) хүний шинж.

questions.prompt: Gap d)
questions.explanation: Ягаанд дуртай хүмүүс “dream of love and enjoy giving flowers” буюу хайр дурлалыг мөрөөдөж, цэцэг бэлэглэх дуртай тул “romantic” (романтик сэтгэлгээтэй) орно.

questions.prompt: Gap e)
questions.explanation: Нил ягаан өнгөнд дуртай хүмүүсийн тухай “Other people find them hard to understand” гэсэн нь тэднийг “mysterious” (нууцлаг) гэж харуулна; “jealous” үг хэрэглэгдэхгүй үлдэнэ.

questions.prompt: By 2035, Riverton's population will have grown …
options: … is new factories attracting young families.
… will probably stay about the same.
… at least two new schools will be needed.
questions.explanation: “grow to” (…хүртэл өсөх) хэллэгт тохирох төгсгөл нь “… to about 60,000”; тайланд “the population will reach about 60,000 by 2035” гэж бичсэн.

questions.prompt: The main reason for the growth …
options: … is new factories attracting young families.
… will probably stay about the same.
… at least two new schools will be needed.
answers: … is new factories attracting young families.
questions.answerDisplay: 2. … is new factories attracting young families.
questions.explanation: Өсөлтийн шалтгааныг “mainly because new factories are attracting young families” гэж заасан тул “The main reason for the growth … is new factories attracting young families”.

questions.prompt: Because there will be more children, …
options: … is new factories attracting young families.
… will probably stay about the same.
… at least two new schools will be needed.
answers: … at least two new schools will be needed.
questions.answerDisplay: 5. … at least two new schools will be needed.
questions.explanation: Хүүхдийн тоо “from 9,000 to around 13,000” болж өсөх учир тайланд дурдсанчлан “… at least two new schools will be needed” (дор хаяж хоёр шинэ сургууль хэрэгтэй болно).

questions.prompt: The number of people aged 65 or more …
options: … is new factories attracting young families.
… will probably stay about the same.
… at least two new schools will be needed.
questions.explanation: 65-аас дээш насныхны тоо “from 6,000 to 11,000” болж өсөх нь бараг хоёр дахин нэмэгдэнэ гэсэн үг тул “… will almost double”.

questions.prompt: After 2035, the population …
options: … is new factories attracting young families.
… will probably stay about the same.
… at least two new schools will be needed.
answers: … will probably stay about the same.
questions.answerDisplay: 3. … will probably stay about the same.
questions.explanation: 2035 оноос хойш “the population will probably remain stable at around 60,000” гэсэн бөгөөд “remain stable” нь өөрчлөгдөхгүй гэсэн утгатай тул “… will probably stay about the same”.

questions.prompt: Emma first flew in a balloon
questions.explanation: Эмма “for my twentieth birthday my parents gave me a balloon flight as a present” гэж хэлсэн тул тэр анх төрсөн өдрийн бэлгээр агаарын бөмбөлгөөр ниссэн.

questions.prompt: According to Emma, a balloon
options: goes where the wind takes it.
answers: goes where the wind takes it.
questions.answerDisplay: goes where the wind takes it.
questions.explanation: Эммагийн хэлснээр “A balloon can't really be steered. It goes where the wind takes it” буюу бөмбөлгийг жолоодох боломжгүй, салхи хаашаа хийсгэнэ, тийшээ л нисдэг.

questions.prompt: Emma never flies when
options: the wind is stronger than about 15 km per hour.
there are more than eight passengers.
answers: the wind is stronger than about 15 km per hour.
questions.answerDisplay: the wind is stronger than about 15 km per hour.
questions.explanation: Эмма “We never fly if the wind is stronger than about fifteen kilometres an hour” гэжээ; “fifteen kilometres an hour” нь цагт 15 км гэсэн үг.

questions.prompt: Where did the dangerous flight happen?
questions.explanation: Хөтлөгч “You had a famous adventure in Turkey” гэж асуухад Эмма “I was flying with eight passengers over Cappadocia” гэж хариулсан тул “over Cappadocia in Turkey”.

questions.prompt: During the emergency, Emma
options: flew higher and then landed in a field.
answers: flew higher and then landed in a field.
questions.answerDisplay: flew higher and then landed in a field.
questions.explanation: Эмма “I took the balloon up higher, above the power lines. Then I looked for an open field and made a fast landing” гэсэн тул эхлээд өндөрт гарч, дараа нь талбайд буусан.

questions.prompt: Emma teaches young pilots mainly to
options: stay calm and make decisions under pressure.
answers: stay calm and make decisions under pressure.
questions.answerDisplay: stay calm and make decisions under pressure.
questions.explanation: Эмма “I mostly teach young pilots how to stay calm and make decisions under pressure” гэж хэлсэн; бөмбөлөг жолоодох нь харин “the easy part” (хялбар хэсэг) гэжээ.

passages.title: The Long Journey of the Monarch Butterfly
passages.text:
Every autumn, millions of orange and black monarch butterflies leave Canada and the northern United States and fly south. Their journey can be as long as 4,000 kilometres, and it ends in a few mountain forests in central Mexico. There, the butterflies gather in such huge numbers that the branches of the trees bend under their weight.

For a long time, nobody knew where the monarchs went in winter. A Canadian scientist, Fred Urquhart, spent decades trying to answer this question. He and thousands of volunteers attached tiny paper labels to the wings of butterflies and asked anyone who found one to report it. Finally, in 1975, two members of his team found the winter forests in Mexico. Urquhart was so excited that he travelled there himself the following year.

The most surprising fact about this journey is that no single butterfly makes the whole round trip. Summer monarchs live for only two to six weeks. The generation that flies south, however, can live for up to eight months. In spring these butterflies start to fly north, lay their eggs and die. Their children and grandchildren complete the journey back to Canada. Somehow, each new generation knows the way, even though it has never made the trip before. Scientists believe the butterflies use the position of the sun and the Earth's magnetic field to find their direction.

Sadly, the number of monarchs has fallen sharply in recent decades. Their caterpillars can only eat one kind of plant, milkweed. Unfortunately, **it** is disappearing as farms grow larger and farmers use more chemicals. In Mexico, illegal cutting of trees has damaged the winter forests. Governments in all three countries are now working together, and many families plant milkweed in their gardens to help. As one Mexican guide says, 'The butterflies don't know borders. If we want to keep them, we have to protect them everywhere.'

sourceNote: 2022–2026 оны жишиг эх нь албан БҮТ-ийн эх биш, нийтэд нээлттэй хуулбар; 2018–2020 оны албан хувилбарын бүтцийг баримталсан.
